## Example Chat Connector for GenAI

[Source Code](https://git.example.com/chat-mcp) | [#chat-mcp](https://chat.example.com/archives/C0000000000) | [Jane Doe (jdoe@)](https://people.example.com/jdoe) | [John Roe (jroe@)](https://people.example.com/jroe)

---

A chat MCP server for an enterprise chat workspace, giving AI assistants full access to messages, channels, search, reactions, files, canvases, lists, reminders, scheduling, drafts, DMs, channel management, status, unreads, and saved messages. 90 tools, 11 resources, 4 prompts with enriched results, thread context, and advanced search.

**SSO authentication, zero config.** The server reuses your existing single sign-on session, so your AI assistant has access to your workspace immediately.
